svg.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Neue', 'Bradley Hand', casual, sans-serif
svg.title: Biasing: one reference, one wire per consumer
svg.desc: bias_ref makes the reference: 0.6 V vref to tx_bias and 100 uA each to rx_bias and clk_bias. tx_bias sinks the six tail currents of pam4_driver, 16 mA in total, and one 6 mA current that tx_predrv_bias turns into six 100 uA references, one per predriver_cml. rx_bias makes vtt (0.55 V) for rx_term, vctrl (0.35 V) for vga, and 38 reference currents for ctle, vga, the 24 slicers and the 12 CML demultiplexers. clk_bias makes 12 reference currents for the clocking cells. The cells in dashed boxes have no bias pin yet, so their currents end at the top level. 24 threshold_dac cells give the 24 slicers their references.

g.text: Biasing: one reference, one wire per consumer
Every bias starts at bias_ref. Each block gives every consumer its own wire. The numbers are the nominal values.
six tail currents, 16 mA in total
Dashed red: the cell has no bias pin yet. Its reference current is generated and ends at the top level.
CMOS on one side, CML on the other
